comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (90%) to Anoplin L: 40%, K: 30%. Activity: Active against S. aureus ATCC 25923 (MIC 22 ug/ml) and E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 16 ug/ml). Structure: random coil in water and helical in 50% TFE.
reference_text: J Pept Sci. 2005 Feb;11(2):113-21. doi: 10.1002/psc.598. PubMed
title: Structure-activity relationship study of anoplin.

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (43.9%) to fish HbbetaP-1 V: 17%, A: 19%, H: 11%. Activity: Active against M. tuberculosis. exhibited a maximum of 53% inhibition at 50 uM. In vitro toxicity: caused a minimal damge (13%) to human macrophages at 50 uM.
title: RapTB: a lung-derived hemoglobin fragment with activity against Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
